title: Ergosphere Geometry and Thermodynamic Properties of Boosted Kerr-Taub-NUT Solutions in Kaluza-Klein Theory
summary: We investigate rotating black holes obtained by applying a Kaluza-Klein boost to the Kerr-Taub-NUT spacetime and study the resulting four-dimensional geometry and thermodynamics after dimensional reduction. The boost along the compact direction generates an Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton black hole in which the electric charge originates purely from higher-dimensional momentum rather than from an independent matter source.
